# microsoft-copilot-archive-bot-builder

> A reusable Microsoft 365 Copilot + SharePoint playbook for building a
> narrowly scoped, read-only Archive Agent over one approved SharePoint
> folder. Source-grounded retrieval only; never invent facts.

## Files

- [README.md](README.md): Full playbook — six-step method, evidence
  hierarchy, pilot matrix, permissions, governance.
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): Agent-facing entry point — read this first.
  What to ask the user for, what to produce, hard rules.
- [agent-instructions.md](agent-instructions.md): Paste-ready agent
  instructions for the SharePoint Agent Builder. Use verbatim after
  replacing `[APPROVED_ARCHIVE_PATH]`.
- [examples/fictional-archive-example.md](examples/fictional-archive-example.md):
  One complete filled-in example, fictional values only.
- [templates/owner-record.md](templates/owner-record.md): Owner record
  template (README §8.1).
- [templates/pilot-test-log.csv](templates/pilot-test-log.csv): Pilot
  test log template (README §6).

## Optional

- [README-start-here-snippet.md](README-start-here-snippet.md): The
  "give this repo to an agent" prompt block to add at the top of README.md.
